title: UAV Scenario Lidar
source_docs: UAV Toolbox/UAV Scenario and Sensor Modeling/UAV_Scenario_Lidar.md
text: Simulate lidar measurements based on meshes in scenario, 1 output; {Sensor name} sets the lidar sensor name, {Max range}, {Range Accuracy} sets the range accuracy of lidar, {Azimuthal limits}, {Azimuthal resolution}, {Elevation limits}, {Elevation resolution}, {Add noise to measurement}, {Output organized point cloud locations} sets the output point cloud locations and {Sample Time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Pointcloud
ports.summary: Point cloud data N -by- M -by-3 double matrix | N -by-3 double matrix

params.name: Azimuthal limits
params.values: Azimuthal limits of lidar [-180, 180] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Elevation limits
params.values: Elevation limits of lidar [-20, 20] (default) | two-element vector
